description: This file defines a UI component named 'NotesGrid' using LightningJS framework. It manages the rendering of a grid of note cards, handling layout computation and emitting events for editing and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesGrid
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays notes in a grid layout, managing layout responsiveness and emitting events for note interactions.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates the number of columns for the grid based on the available width, ensuring at least one column.

methods.name: emitEdit
methods.description: Emits an 'editNote' event with the note detail when an edit action is triggered.

methods.name: emitDelete
methods.description: Emits a 'deleteNote' event with the note id when a delete action is triggered.
